scope_limit: The with/without multi-omics comparison now has an executable, paired and gated contract. Two declared arms must match on candidate, label, fold and budget digests and on the initialisation seed, and must differ only in the omics node input, otherwise the pair is refused before any score is read. The estimator is verified on synthetic scores: per-cancer average precision and ROC AUC, a paired stratified bootstrap interval, an exact sign test and a paired sign-flip permutation test, including a planted improvement and a null case. The only reporting entry point refuses while either arm has no trained checkpoint, which is the current state: no arm was trained with multi-omics node input, so no effect is reported and the tempting shortcut of scoring the existing G2 checkpoint with and without the new input columns is refused explicitly. Two attempts were blocked before execution by an intranet SSH banner error; after the read-only probe returned 149 the run was repeated once, no remote execution had occurred, and no duplicate job was launched. No optimizer, real cohort, paid compute or deployment ran.
